description: The agent must: (1) Read creator_profile.json to extract raw scores and business parameters. (2) Apply the SKILL.md 4-dimension content value rubric with exact sub-weights — critically, 'uniqueness', 'market_size', 'trust', and 'virality' have rubric maximums of 5pts (not 10), so raw scores must be scaled proportionally (e.g., uniqueness raw=6/10 → scaled to (6/10)*5=3 out of 5). Total score = 73.5, yielding a 4-star rating (60-79 range). (3) Apply the value pricing formula: user monthly income increase (4000 CNY) × 12 months × 10% = 4800 CNY for value-based price. (4) Apply the revenue formula: 15000 traffic × 2.5% conversion × 399 unit price = 149,625 CNY/month. (5) Include a growth projection across all 4 time periods (1, 3, 6, 12 months). (6) Include tiered pricing (基础版/标准版/高级版). (7) Include channel recommendations featuring knowledge payment platforms. (8) Include an execution checklist with phases. The key proprietary traps are: the /10→/5 sub-score scaling, the exact value pricing formula, and the specific 4-period growth model.
